title: fix(ui): refresh MCP app colors after lazy themes load
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes already-open MCP apps keeping the previous palette when a newly selected Control UI theme finishes loading.

## User Impact

Embedded apps update their backgrounds, text, borders, and status colors when the selected palette is ready, without requiring a resize or reopening the app.

## Why This Change Was Made

Notify theme subscribers after deferred palette application even when the mascot and hat stay unchanged. Immediate preference updates, synchronous notification coalescing, stale-generation/disposal guards, and the existing MCP token adapter are preserved.

## Evidence

Actual Control UI components and AppBridge with the canonical mocked Gateway and a synthetic MCP protocol fixture, not an authenticated external MCP server. The first Tide stylesheet response was held and released while the same app remained mounted; no resize occurred.

### Before

![Before: embedded app remains on the previous light palette](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/9793bec3-9633-4939-8bc6-646e27696c70)

### After

![After: embedded app receives the selected Tide dark palette](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/6ec6e27e-4341-4bec-9449-a6cb0ffd3de1)

- Browser proof: the app previously stayed light with `#ffffff` after the host became Tide dark; it now receives dark mode and `#161d25`. Mounted identities stayed unchanged and resize count remained zero.
- Five owner regressions pass, covering deferred load/error completion, synchronous coalescing, supersession and disposal. Original source fails both deferred-palette cases. Changed test file: 4.69 s wall.
- Broader scoped context/MCP validation: 88 tests passed across nine files; relevant types, formatting, lint/style checks, repository guards and independent P0–P2 review passed.
- This independent branch preserves the exact reviewed owner/test bytes. Full production build and live-backend verification were not run.

Requested by @vyctorbrzezowski as part of the Control UI theme-drift audit.
